summary: Helios Technologies filed an 8-K announcing a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.12 per share, payable July 24, 2026 to holders of record July 10, 2026. This is the company's 118th consecutive quarterly dividend, reflecting a 29-year history of consistent payouts. No special dividend, tender offer, or capital return event is involved. The filing contains no deal terms, premium, or structural changes. As a routine dividend declaration, this does not constitute a special situation. The company has approximately 33.0 million shares outstanding, making the aggregate payment about $3.96 million.
